{{Quote|My father died in the great Battle of the Plains, avenging the great wrong of the Melida during the Battle of the North &mdash;|Hologram of Micae|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of the Plains''' occurred at some point of the [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] [[Melida/Daan Civil War|Civil War]]. [[Micae]]'s father, [[Terandi]], died in that battle. The [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] had waged it to take revenge on the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] for the [[Battle of the North]], which occurred over a century before.
